messages:
sara: Quick live thread from today's All-Hands — collecting follow-ups about hybrid/workspace and offsite travel. I'll answer what we can now. Drop any other Qs and we'll update the FAQ. :wave:

oliver: Can managers require a set number of in-office days for project milestones, or does that need to be in the job/goal docs?

sara: Managers can set expectations for milestone work, but anything tied to performance or promotion should be documented in the role/goal plan and applied equitably. People Ops will help review fairness if needed.

katie: If my team books a recurring "team day", should that be on the company calendar or team calendar?

sara: Team calendar is fine. If it uses shared rooms, AV, or impacts other teams, notify your GM so Facilities can reserve spaces and avoid conflicts.

jamal: Offsite logistics: who handles visas and special travel letters? Any deadline?

sara: People Ops provides visa/invitation letters for company-sponsored offsites. Put a note in the travel request form (field: visa_support). Submit travel requests 30 days before international travel to allow time for visas.

ops-bot: Reminder: submit travel requests 21 days for domestic, 30+ days for international. Use project code EXP-OFFSITE-2026 on receipts.

oliver: Childcare/partner coverage for offsites? Heard about a pilot.

sara: Yes  small childcare/partner stipend pilot for select 2026 offsites. Eligibility and how to apply will be on the travel page. Managers can request exceptions for critical contributors.

katie: ADA accommodations and confidential requests process?

sara: Contact People Ops privately and we'll handle accommodations confidentially. We'll also post a short guide for managers on inclusive in-office norms.

jamal: Who signs off if someone needs extra nights or alternate dates for family reasons?

sara: Operational exceptions: manager + People Ops. Budget impacts escalate to Finance + GM. For emergencies, tag me and ops-bot and we'll fast-track approvals.

oliver: Any preferred vendors for group bookings? Want to lock rates for a week-long workshop.

sara: Preferred vendors are on the travel form dropdown. If a vendor isn't listed, pick "other" and tag procurement; they can negotiate group rates. Facilities needs 7 business days to reserve rooms and AV.

ops-bot: Tip: use the travel form to auto-create expense codes and route approvals. Finance target for standard reimbursements is ~12 business days.

sara: Action items: 1) Update the hybrid/offsite FAQ and pin it in People Ops by next Monday. 2) Publish a short manager checklist for team in-office norms. 3) Add childcare pilot details and preferred vendor list to the travel page. I'll post links here when live. DM me for private follow-ups.
